How do I make my subverse show the latest posts at the top?

Not at the moment. It’s been requested before, and if it gets added as a feature, it would likely be a simple option in your subverse settings.

I doubt it’ll be implemented anytime soon if at all, as link aggregators like Voat thrive on popular (or “good”) content as defined by majority opinion. Even if you feel your particular subverse makes more sense in chronological order, other people may not be interested in that, and just want to see the good bits filtered by users before them.

A service like Twitter or a blog would be more suited for chronological content.

So I think this whole decentralization argument is a double edged sword. While I have definitely observed the "partisanizing" of the mainstream media to the point that I can't truly trust everything they say, I do have a smaller number of sources to check to determine my personal opinion than I would in a decentralized world. In that world, where no real editorial authority exists, I can imagine having to visit tons of websites to be able to decode who is throwing around total BS, who is just a little partisan and who is selling me straight. It is like noise pollution at a concert, I know what I am there attempting to listen to, but if everyone is able to bring along their acoustic guitars and demo tapes, it will become nearly impossible to hone in on the real song. I'm going to spend more time fact checking, cross-sourcing and evaluating other articles for bias than I am actually reading the news. Even if all I want to know is the forecast for my frozen concentrated orange juice investment.
